rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=30, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0002, outer_wall_s=900, seed=42, rationale=iter-7 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: image BF range sigma img_sr 0.0005->0.0002 (even tighter edge-preservation). proj_sr REVERTED to default 0.02 (iter-6 tightened proj_sr->0.0005 and hr DROPPED 0.1257->0.1003 = edge-hard projection filtering causes view inconsistency, findings.md confirmed; proj domain stays gentle). CHAMPION = iter-5 (img_sr=0.0005) hr=0.1257 SSIM0.9605 PSNR39.57. HYPOTHESIS: the image-domain range sigma is the live lever; 0.02->0.0005 gained +0.126 hr by making the BF stop at intensity edges. A yet-tighter 0.0002 preserves MORE fibroglandular edge detail -> hr climbs further, UNLESS the kernel becomes near-identity (range so tight the BF barely averages -> no denoising -> recon regresses toward the raw noisy FBP, hr back toward 0). This iter locates which side of the sweet spot 0.0005 is on: if hr>0.1257 keep tightening (0.0001); if hr<0.1257 the optimum is at/above 0.0005 (next: 0.001). BUDGET: value change, ~1000s. ONE knob: img_sr 0.0005->0.0002.
